projectSelection.startChatWithProvider: Выберите проект для начала чата с {{provider}}

executionModes.title: Execution mode
executionModes.default: Asks before every tool it has not been granted.
executionModes.plan: Investigates and proposes a plan. Changes nothing.
executionModes.acceptEdits: Edits files without asking. Still asks before running commands.
executionModes.auto: Decides routine calls itself; asks about the rest.
executionModes.bypassPermissions: Runs everything without asking. Use on throwaway work only.
